turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have twenty minutes before a client call. My son found out he got a zero on his phone, in the middle of your class. Tell me why nobody called me first.
Don't thank me yet. Did you call me before the zero went into the gradebook, yes or no?
The file was created at 11:31 PM. 612 words appeared at 11:52 PM and 794 more at 11:58 PM.
I'm writing down 11:31, 11:52 and 11:58, and the 612 and 794 words. Those are the times and numbers you've given me, Hale. Where did the file come from, and who looked at it besides you?
How long after the file was created did the first words appear?
Twenty-one minutes, by your own numbers. Owen writes in bursts, and I don't see why that's a crime. Answer my question first: who has seen this, and did anyone ask him about it before the zero?
What time is it now, by the way?
Quarter to five is close enough. I have a call at 4:40, so I'm counting. Did anyone ask Owen about this before the zero went in?
